snippet.title: [OP] The Hepatica Spring
snippet.description:
The Hepatica Spring is a Nordic fairytale-inspired fantasy visual novel. Find romance or friendship in a beautiful bathhotel as the magical night of Midsummer approaches!

PLAY ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1883990/The_Hepatica_Spring/
PLAY ON ITCH: https://gallium-games.itch.io/the-hepatica-spring
